claim: Maps irregular physical domains into a latent regular domain to retain Fourier operator computation.
claim_zh: 学习随几何变化的坐标变形，在规则潜在域中使用傅里叶算子层。
innovation_detail: Learn geometry-dependent coordinate deformations and apply Fourier layers in a regular latent domain.
innovation_detail_zh: 学习随几何变化的坐标变形，在规则潜在域中使用傅里叶算子层。
bottleneck: Standard FNO parameterizations have difficulty with nonrectangular domains and irregular meshes.
bottleneck_zh: 标准FNO对非规则几何和非均匀网格的表示能力有限。
tradeoff: Geometric generalization remains dependent on the training distribution.
